_readme: Every project on the site lives here. Edit this file, then run: python scripts/build_portfolio.py. The site is one page: projects with a spotlight (and home not false) get a large section with the live site embedded; everything else with featured: true becomes a card under 'More work'. hidden: true keeps an entry here without publishing it. live / repo can be null.

projects.name: Snowline
projects.tagline: Daily Montana snow cover from Sentinel-2, Landsat, and SNOTEL.
projects.description: Satellite snow extent fused with SNOTEL depth and webcams for southwest Montana, updated daily. The first piece of the Line Network — RiverLine and SkyLine are next.

spotlight.headline: Where the snow is today, from space.
points: Daily snow extent from Sentinel-2 and Landsat
Every SNOTEL station, compared against its 20-year median
Free, and open source from October 10

projects.name: Data4MT
projects.tagline: Montana's parcel, permit, and zoning records in one statewide map.
projects.description: Parcels and ownership, building and septic permits, 2,779 conservation easements, zoning, FEMA flood, water rights, and a 2016–2025 change explorer. Available as a data feed for Montana businesses.

spotlight.headline: Montana's public records, in one map.
points: 2,779 conservation easements, zoning, FEMA flood, and water rights
A 2016–2025 change explorer for subdivisions and sales

projects.name: Gallatin Continuity
projects.tagline: Habitat and hydrologic continuity across the Gallatin Valley.
projects.description: An interactive StoryMap showing how habitat and water connect across the valley, built for the Gallatin Watershed Council.

spotlight.headline: How water rules change along one creek.
points: Follows Bozeman Creek from the wilderness to the East Gallatin River
Shows how governance shifts across natural, rural, park, residential, and urban zones
Built as an interactive story with the Gallatin Watershed Council

projects.name: Montana Airport Economic Impact
projects.tagline: Statewide airport economics — passengers, capital investment, workforce.
projects.description: Economic impact of every Montana airport, mapped and told as a StoryMap.
projects.partner: Zenith Economics and the MSU Geospatial Core Facility

spotlight.headline: What Montana's airports are worth to the state.
points: Every public airport in Montana, mapped
Passenger counts, capital investment, and workforce trends
Built with Zenith Economics and the MSU Geospatial Core Facility

projects.name: Roadside
projects.tagline: Read Montana and Idaho highway markers without pulling over.
projects.description: 673 official historical and geologic markers with sign text and photos, as open data. Exports to GPX, KML, and Wikidata. No server, no API keys.

projects.name: Salmon River Permit Alerts
projects.tagline: An email when a Four Rivers permit date opens up.
projects.description: Watches Recreation.gov for cancellations on the Middle Fork, Main Salmon, and Selway.

projects.name: Map Digitizer
projects.tagline: Turn a screenshot of a zoning map into GeoJSON, Shapefile, or KML.
projects.description: Georeferences and vectorizes planning maps from PDFs or images. Beta.

projects.name: Churchhouse Rule$
projects.tagline: Every game we play, written down.
projects.description: A rulebook friends can edit straight from the site. Every save is a commit.
